Apple’s demand for displays, ultra-thin glass, hinges and device components could accelerate supply-chain technology development and mass-manufacturing capacity over the medium to long term, the report noted.

TrendForce sees 2026 as a year of structural transformation for the foldable smartphone market, with Apple’s entry potentially prompting Samsung and Chinese manufacturers to rethink their foldable strategies. The shift could accelerate upgrades in technical specifications, drive cost cuts and boost innovation in AI-powered features and multitasking interfaces.
